verdict.rationale: Muse's official safety documentation explicitly states trajectories are sanitized of PII before training by default, and users can fully opt out of model training via a simple toggle in settings, directly giving knowledge-workers control over training use of their conversations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the opt-out actually stops training data collection in practice, and no detail on granularity (e.g., per-conversation vs. global opt-out).
